channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: ICE Raids Impact Meatpackers, Potentially Raising Prices
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) raids in states that voted heavily for Donald Trump are reportedly causing meatpacking companies to lose millions in revenue. Meatpacking groups have stated that these arrests could lead to higher… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China's Gig Workers Face Increasing Difficulty Finding Work
item.description: Gig workers in China are reporting that finding employment is becoming progressively more challenging. The situation is described as 'work is getting harder and harder to find' by those on the street. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Royale Impex Celebrates 28 Years in Marble Industry
item.description: Royale Impex, a prominent marble company in India, is celebrating 28 years of operation. The company has marked this milestone with a focus on its legacy and excellence within the industry. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran has identified three near-term risks facing India: challenges in US trade relations, energy security, and the artificial intelligence (AI) gap. Nageswaran suggested India needs strategic hedging… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FM Sitharaman: Centre Supports Manufacturing to Reduce Dependency
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the Centre is providing necessary support to the manufacturing sector to reduce dependency. This support aims to bolster domestic production and self-reliance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FD Rules to Change from October 1
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has decided to change Fixed Deposit (FD) rules, which will come into effect from October 1. These changes are expected to make rules stricter for those purchasing property from Non-Resident Indians (NRIs). Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Banks to Open Sunday Ahead of Proposed Strike
item.description: Government banks will remain open on Sunday, September 24, in anticipation of a proposed three-day strike by bank employees from September 28 to September 30. This decision aims to mitigate disruption for bank customers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Welspun Corp Secures ₹4,000 Crore US Pipe Order
item.description: Welspun Corp's US-based arm has secured an order worth ₹4,000 crore for High-Frequency Induction Welded (HFIW) pipes from a US facility. The company's stock saw gains following the announcement of this record order. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Rapido has launched its food delivery application, Ownly, in Hyderabad. This marks the app's expansion to its second city, following an initial launch in Bengaluru. Ownly aims to operate on a zero-commission model. Rapido plans to scale… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Maruti Suzuki India has commissioned its first green hydrogen plant at its Manesar facility in Haryana. The plant has a capacity of 300 kW. This initiative marks the company's move towards sustainable energy solutions. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: Prestige Estates has launched two new residential projects in Bengaluru. One project, located in Devanahalli, is valued at Rs 1,750 crore. The company anticipates a total revenue of Rs 2,850 crore from these two new housing developments. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Brightline, a private equity-backed railway company operating high-speed trains in Florida, has filed for bankruptcy in court. The company is restructuring its debt as part of the bankruptcy proceedings. Despite the bankruptcy filing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Akamai and Anthropic Sign $11.6 Billion Cloud Services Deal
item.description: Akamai Technologies has signed a seven-year cloud services agreement with Anthropic valued at $11.6 billion. As part of the deal, Akamai will also grant Anthropic a warrant for up to a 5% stake in the company. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Costco Reports Increased Profit and Revenue
item.description: Costco reported higher profits and revenue for its fourth quarter, driven by resilient consumer spending. The company exceeded sales estimates, with demand remaining strong for essential goods. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Officials at the U.S. Federal Reserve believe interest rates will likely need to increase further to combat high inflation. A deputy governor at the Bank of England stated that a rate rise is becoming increasingly probable if energy prices… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Americans' Economic Sentiment Remains Negative
item.description: Despite some potential improvements, Americans continue to hold a negative view of the economy, feeling worse about it than at nearly any point in modern history, according to CNN. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Bond yields are experiencing a sustained increase, driven by ongoing inflation fears that are keeping financial markets on edge. This rise in yields has led to a decline in stock prices, further exacerbated by higher oil prices. Financial… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 18 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury Yields Reach 2007 Highs, Worrying Investors
item.description: US Treasury yields have reached their highest levels since 2007, causing concern among investors. The rising bond rates are presenting a new challenge, with implications for the Federal Reserve. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Windfall Tax Cut Could Cost Billions, Campaigners Warn
item.description: Campaigners have warned that an early scrapping of the UK's windfall tax could cost the country £8.6 billion by 2030. The tax, levied on the profits of oil and gas companies, was introduced to help mitigate the impact of high energy prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The US bond market experienced its worst day since April 2025 on Wednesday, with the 30-year US Treasury yield surpassing 5.43%. This marked the highest level for the yield since 2004. The selloff in global bonds continued, keeping yields… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Embassy REIT has raised ₹1,000 crores through the issuance of three-year floating-rate Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). The financing was fully subscribed by a leading European multinational bank. This marks the first bank financing at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dabur India to acquire Ayurvedic brand Sesa Care after NCLT approval
item.description: Dabur India has received approval from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) to merge its Ayurvedic hair-care brand Sesa Care into its portfolio. This move is intended to strengthen Dabur's premium Ayurvedic hair-care segment. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
